candidates.source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo national e-procurement platform (KRPP/PPRC)
candidates.why_relevant: Single mandatory portal where every Kosovo contracting authority publishes contract notices (B05 'Njoftim per Kontrate'), award notices (B08 'Njoftim per dhenie te kontrates') and signed-contract notices (B52). Tender dossiers and technical specifications state quantities of ATMs, POS terminals, card personalisation volumes and switch capacity that no CBK/statistical publication reports. Document pages are directly addressable, e.g. .../SPIN_PROD/application/ipn/DocumentManagement/DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=3489060.
candidates.access_status: public for notices; full dossier download may require registered economic-operator account
candidates.legal_status: public official publication mandated by Law on Public Procurement
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OCDS API (ocdskrpp.rks-gov.net) for structured harvesting; use the DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id= document endpoints for the notice PDFs; filter by CPV/keyword (bankomat, ATM, terminale POS, sistem pagesash, personalizim kartelash).
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from Posta e Kosoves procurement page
queries_used: e-Prokurimi Kosove njoftim per kontrate bankomat ATM terminale POS
Posta e Kosoves tender POS terminale prokurim njoftim kontrate

candidates.source_name: KRPP / PPRC OCDS API — Open Contracting data for Kosovo procurement
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable Open Contracting Data Standard feed of the whole e-Prokurimi corpus: tender titles, buyers, suppliers, values, procedure type, lots, awards. Coverage reported March 2016 - March 2026 with bulk JSONL.gz / XLSX / CSV downloads (all-time JSON ~23 MB). This is the highest-leverage single endpoint for systematically finding every ATM/POS/payment-system contract in Kosovo over a decade.
candidates.legal_status: government open data; licence not declared in OCP registry
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download annual bulk files, index tender/award titles and descriptions, keyword-filter in sq/sr/en, then follow through to the e-Prokurimi notice PDFs for technical quantities. Note documented data-quality issues (nulls, misspelled 'award' field, non-standard Lots field names).
candidates.discovered_via_method: pointer snowball from OCP Data Registry
queries_used: Open Data Kosovo procurement "Open Procurement" portal tenders database Kosovo

candidates.source_name: KRPP — Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik (Public Procurement Regulatory Commission)
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator and operator of the notice regime; publishes annual public-procurement reports (aggregate contract values by sector/CPV), the notice-form standards (B05/B08/B52) needed to parse dossiers, legislation, and an archive. Essential for interpreting and normalising the tender corpus.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the annual-report and legislation sections; use to build the CPV/form schema for parsing e-Prokurimi notices.
queries_used: KRPP Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik njoftim per dhenie kontrate sistem pagesash

candidates.source_name: Prokurimi Hapur / Otvorena nabavka — Open Procurement Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: Civil-society re-publication and analytics layer over Kosovo procurement data, available in Albanian, Serbian (sr-Latn) and English. Usually far easier to search and filter by buyer/supplier than the government portal, and preserves records that rotate off e-Prokurimi. Useful for identifying which vendors repeatedly win ATM/POS/payment-system lots.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search per language (sq/sr-Latn/en) for bankomat/ATM/POS/platni sistem; cross-check hits back to the primary e-Prokurimi notice before using any figure.
queries_used: e-prokurimi rks-gov.net obavestenje o ugovoru srpski nabavka bankomata platni sistem Kosovo

candidates.source_name: OSHP — Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit (Procurement Review Body) decisions & complaint database
candidates.why_relevant: Complaint decisions quote tender technical specifications, bid prices, unit counts and evaluation detail that are often redacted or absent from the published notice. Searchable by contracting authority, economic operator, tender category and value — an excellent way to reconstruct disputed ATM/POS/card-system procurements and the competing vendors.
candidates.access_status: public web application with search and report endpoints
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Drive the /sq/ProcurementActivities/Search endpoint with filters and paginate; pull decision PDFs; also harvest /sq/Reports/* aggregate tables.
queries_used: OSHP Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit Kosove vendimet ankesa tender

candidates.source_name: Demokracia Plus — OSHP decisions database (oshp.dplus.org)
candidates.why_relevant: NGO-built, full-text searchable mirror of Procurement Review Body decisions — typically more scrape-friendly than the official OSHP application and retains older decisions. Good fallback pointer into disputed payment-infrastructure tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-text keyword crawl in Albanian; verify any extracted figure against the official OSHP decision.
queries_used: OSHP Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit Kosove vendimet ankesa tender

candidates.source_name: AQP — Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit (Central Procurement Agency, Ministry of Finance)
candidates.why_relevant: Runs joint/framework procurements on behalf of all central and local contracting authorities, and publishes the signed contracts and decisions itself. Whole-of-government framework contracts (e.g. banking services, card/fuel-card style supplies, payment acceptance for public bodies) would run through here and state aggregate quantities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /dokumenti/, /raportet/ and /vendime/ listings; watch the annual joint-procurement plan for payment-related lots.
queries_used: Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit AQP Kosove kontrata publike njoftimet

candidates.source_name: BQK / CBK — Tenderet (Central Bank of Kosovo procurement notices)
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank operates the interbank payment system and is building a TIPS-clone instant-payments scheme; its own tender and award notices are the only public window on procurement of payment-switch, RTGS/instant-payment, cash-handling and currency-processing infrastructure. CBK publishes award notices as PDFs on its own site (own procurement rules in force since 01.12.2024) in addition to e-Prokurimi.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the tenderet listing plus the wp-content PDF paths; diff monthly; join with CBK payment-system regulation pages for context.
candidates.discovered_via_method: actor-map inference (who regulates/operates payments) + Albanian search
queries_used: Banka Qendrore e Republikes se Kosoves prokurimi njoftim per kontrate tender
BQK tender "sistemi i pagesave" instant payments Kosovo procurement contract switch
local_language_terms_used: Banka Qendrore e Republikes se Kosoves

candidates.source_name: Posta e Kosovës — Procurement / Prokurimi
candidates.why_relevant: State-owned postal operator with counter networks and payment/bill-collection services — a realistic public buyer of POS terminals, cash-handling and counter payment systems. Publishes its own 'Njoftim per dhenie te kontrates' documents in parallel with e-Prokurimi.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the /download/njoftim-per-dhenie-te-kontrates-* series and the procurement listing; parse award PDFs for lot quantities.
candidates.discovered_via_method: actor-map inference (state-linked payment-touching entities) + Albanian search
queries_used: Posta e Kosoves tender POS terminale prokurim njoftim kontrate

candidates.source_name: Dogana e Kosovës — procurement announcement files (AnnouncementFiles)
candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo Customs collects duties at borders and offices and is a live buyer of card-acceptance/POS and cash-handling equipment. Hosts B08 and B52 notice PDFs on a predictable /sharedfolder/AnnouncementFiles/ path, which makes it one of the easiest buyer-side document stores to harvest and a good template for other rks-gov.net bodies.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the announcements index and fetch AnnouncementFiles PDFs; OCR where scanned; filter on POS/terminal/kartele keywords.
queries_used: e-Prokurimi Kosove njoftim per kontrate bankomat ATM terminale POS
local_language_terms_used: B08 njoftim per dhenie te kontrates
B52 njoftimi per nenshkrimin e kontrates

candidates.source_name: KOSTT — Tenders (transmission system operator)
candidates.why_relevant: Representative of the state-owned utility tier (alongside KEK/KESDS/water utilities) whose tenders cover metering, billing and customer-payment collection systems — the channel through which utility bill-payment and POS/kiosk infrastructure enters the market. Utilities are a major driver of cash-vs-card payment behaviour in Kosovo.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of the tenders listing; treat as a lead generator into e-Prokurimi record IDs rather than a primary data store.
queries_used: Posta e Kosoves tender POS terminale prokurim njoftim kontrate

candidates.source_name: Zyra Kombëtare e Auditimit (National Audit Office of Kosovo) — audit reports
candidates.why_relevant: Annual regularity and performance audits of ministries, agencies and publicly-owned enterprises routinely dissect specific contracts, listing values, quantities delivered and implementation failures. Reports frequently expose payment-infrastructure and IT-system contracts in detail unavailable in the tender notice itself. NAO published 19 reports under the 2025/2026 audit plan (11 central, 7 local).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest /cms/DocumentFiles/ PDFs annually; full-text index in Albanian for POS/ATM/kartele/sistem pagesash terms.
queries_used: Zyra Kombetare e Auditimit raport auditimi Posta e Kosoves Telekomi kontrata POS ATM

candidates.source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP) + EBRD procurement notices
candidates.why_relevant: IFI channel: EBRD-financed clients in Kosovo (utilities, SOEs, financial-sector projects) must publish general and specific procurement notices with technical scope. Captures payment/IT infrastructure procurement that never reaches the national portal.
candidates.access_status: public notice browsing; bidding requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Filter notices by country=Kosovo and sector; also monitor the ebrd.com procurement-notices listing as a fallback feed.
queries_used: EBRD World Bank procurement notice Kosovo payment system ATM POS terminals supply

candidates.source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations — Procurement notices and contract awards (Kosovo)
candidates.why_relevant: World Bank-financed Kosovo operations (public finance, digital government, financial-sector) publish General Procurement Notices, Invitations for Bids and contract-award data including supplier and value. Contract-award datasets are also exposed via WBG Finances One, enabling structured extraction of vendors supplying payment/IT systems.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the procurement search filtered to country Kosovo; complement with the Finances One procurement-notice and major-contract-award datasets via their API.
queries_used: EBRD World Bank procurement notice Kosovo payment system ATM POS terminals supply

candidates.source_name: UNDP Kosovo — Procurement notices
candidates.why_relevant: UNDP implements EU/IPA and bilateral projects in Kosovo under indirect management, running its own RFP/ITB procedures. Donor-funded digitalisation and financial-inclusion projects buy payment hardware, card/ID personalisation and e-payment integrations outside the national portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the country procurement page plus UNGM (ungm.org) notices filtered to Kosovo; archive tender documents at publication because UN notices are removed after closing.
queries_used: EU Office in Kosovo calls for tenders IPA contracts payment digitalisation UNDP Kosovo procurement notices

candidates.source_name: IOM Kosovo — Procurement & Tenders
candidates.why_relevant: Second donor-implementer channel in Kosovo; IOM procures cash-assistance disbursement, prepaid-card and payment-service arrangements for beneficiary programmes, which reveal card issuing/acquiring capabilities of local banks and PSPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl; archive tender documents immediately since listings expire.
queries_used: BQK tender "sistemi i pagesave" instant payments Kosovo procurement contract switch

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement)
candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo is not an EU member so its domestic notices are not on TED, but EU external-action and IPA service/supply contracts implemented for Kosovo, plus framework contracts naming Kosovo as place of performance, do appear. Also the place where EU-based vendors' Kosovo-adjacent payment contracts surface.
candidates.access_status: public with free search and open data downloads
candidates.legal_status: official EU publication, reusable open data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use TED expert search / bulk open data with place-of-performance or free-text 'Kosovo' plus CPV codes for ATM, POS and payment-system equipment; expect low but non-zero yield.
queries_used: TED tenders europa.eu Kosovo ATM POS payment system supply contract notice

candidates.source_name: javne-nabavke.com — Kosovo region tender aggregator (Serbian language)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial Serbian-language aggregator covering Kosovo tenders; provides the sr-language entry point (bankomati, POS terminali, platni promet) and a rough sense of volume — its own page reports over 8,000 Kosovo tenders published in 2023 at ~EUR 448k average estimated value. Useful for cross-language keyword discovery rather than as an authoritative record.
candidates.access_status: partly paywalled / subscription for full notice text
candidates.legal_status: commercial republication; check ToS before scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume keyword searching in Serbian to harvest terminology and lead titles; always resolve back to the e-Prokurimi original. Do not bulk-scrape without checking terms of service.
queries_used: "javne nabavke" Kosovo tender bankomati "POS terminali" ugovor
candidates.observed_blocker: Aggregator model implies subscription gating on full notice text; not verified in this pass.

candidates.source_name: Municipal e-Prokurimi sub-portals (e.g. Komuna e Prishtinës)
candidates.why_relevant: All 38 municipalities publish their own procurement pages under the kk.rks-gov.net domain. Municipalities buy cash-desk/POS payment acceptance for tax and utility counters, parking payment systems and kiosk terminals — local-level payment-acceptance demand invisible in national statistics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate municipality slugs under kk.rks-gov.net/<komuna>/e-prokurimi/ and crawl; better still, filter the OCDS dataset by buyer=municipality and only fetch matching notices.
queries_used: e-prokurimi rks-gov.net obavestenje o ugovoru srpski nabavka bankomata platni sistem Kosovo

candidates.source_name: KALLXO.com (BIRN/KDI) — e-prokurimi and KRPP tag archives
candidates.why_relevant: Investigative outlet that continuously reports on specific Kosovo tenders, single-source awards, negotiated procedures without publication, and platform outages (e.g. the six-day e-Prokurimi outage). Best early-warning pointer to contracts worth pulling, and to periods where the portal record is incomplete.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted journalism — cite, do not republish
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the e-prokurimi and KRPP tag feeds; use articles as leads, extract the underlying tender ID and fetch the primary notice.
queries_used: Kallxo KDI "Prokurimi" databaza tendereve Kosove monitorim kontratat publike

candidates.source_name: Global Public Procurement Database (GPPD) — Kosovo (XK) country profile
candidates.why_relevant: World Bank-hosted harmonised procurement statistics for Kosovo — spend by category, procedure type and buyer. Provides the denominator and benchmark against which any ATM/POS contract volumes found in e-Prokurimi should be sized.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic export of the XK country profile for context metrics; not a source of equipment-level detail.
queries_used: Open Data Kosovo procurement "Open Procurement" portal tenders database Kosovo

candidates.source_name: RKS Open Data portal — KRPP organisation datasets
candidates.why_relevant: Government open-data catalogue entry for the procurement regulator; the canonical place to discover any additional published procurement datasets/resources beyond the OCDS API, with Albanian/Serbian/English metadata.
candidates.access_status: public (CKAN-style catalogue, likely has an API)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the organisation's datasets via the catalogue API; register new resources as they appear.
queries_used: KRPP Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik njoftim per dhenie kontrate sistem pagesash

candidates.source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette) — procurement law and secondary legislation
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative text of the Public Procurement Law (No. 04/L-042 and amendments, earlier No. 03/L-241), the Audit Office law (05/L-055) and secondary rules that define what must be published, in what form, and for how long — i.e. the legal basis for the whole collection strategy and for asserting collection_allowed. Also carries the draft Law on Payment Services relevant to the sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off retrieval of the relevant acts, then watch for amendments; use ActDocumentDetail.aspx?ActID= permalinks.
queries_used: Zyra Kombetare e Auditimit raport auditimi Posta e Kosoves Telekomi kontrata POS ATM

negative_findings.description: No specific Kosovo public tender for ATMs (bankomat), POS terminals, card personalisation or a payment switch could be surfaced through general web search in any of sq, sr or en. Search engines index the e-Prokurimi document viewer only sparsely.
negative_findings.result_summary: Five language-varied queries returned the portals and buyers but zero identifiable ATM/POS/payment-system notice. The portal's ASP.NET document viewer (DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=) appears to be largely invisible to search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Item-level discovery in this cell cannot rely on web search; it must go through the OCDS bulk dataset or the portal's own search UI. Any collection design that assumes Google-indexed tender pages will systematically under-report.

negative_findings.description: TED does not carry Kosovo domestic procurement, because Kosovo is neither an EU member nor an EEA party subject to the EU procurement directives.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED searches surfaced only general TED documentation; no Kosovo domestic notices. Only EU external-action/IPA contracts naming Kosovo as place of performance would appear.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The TED leg of this cell has structurally low yield and should be scoped down to EU external-action contracts and the EU Funding & Tenders/enlargement channel rather than treated as a parallel to e-Prokurimi.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'calls for tenders' portal for the EU Office in Kosovo / EU Special Representative was located; EU-funded procurement for Kosovo appears to be routed through indirect management with implementers (UNDP, IOM) or through central EC systems.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned IPA action documents on enlargement.ec.europa.eu but no Kosovo-specific EU tender listing page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Donor-funded payment-infrastructure procurement is fragmented across implementers, so the collection plan needs several small feeds rather than one EU portal; risk of missing contracts is real.

negative_findings.description: Whether full tender dossiers (technical specifications with quantities) on e-Prokurimi are downloadable anonymously or require a registered economic-operator account was not established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Notice-level documents appear publicly addressable; dossier-level access unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The quantity-level intelligence this cell exists to capture lives in the dossier, not the notice. If dossiers are gated, the collection method must fall back to award notices, OSHP decisions and NAO audit reports.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo procurement is thin online. Queries in sr returned regional aggregators rather than Kosovo institutional pages, apart from the Serbian (sr-Latn) interface of prokurimihapur.org and the e-Prokurimi portal's own multilingual notice versions.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr terms (javne nabavke, bankomati, POS terminali, obavestenje o ugovoru, platni sistem) produced Serbia/BiH/Montenegro portals more often than Kosovo records.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language search will not independently discover Kosovo tenders; sr terms are useful for matching inside documents but not as a discovery channel, so sq must be the primary discovery language.

coverage_gaps.description: The CPV codes actually used by Kosovo contracting authorities for ATMs, POS terminals, card personalisation, payment switches and cash-handling equipment have not been enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the OCDS bulk dataset, cluster items by CPV against a keyword-matched training set (bankomat, ATM, terminal POS, kartele bankare, sistem pagesash, aparat per numerim parash), and freeze a CPV allow-list for continuous monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: The buyer roster for payment infrastructure was only partly built. Telekomi i Kosovës / PTK, Trusti i Kursimeve Pensionale, Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës (ATK), Thesari / Ministria e Financave, KEK/KESCO and regional water companies were identified as likely buyers but their individual procurement pages were not opened.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate all central and POE contracting authorities from the KRPP buyer list, and add procurement-page crawlers for the payment-touching subset (tax administration, treasury, utilities, pension trust, telecom).

coverage_gaps.description: The supplier side of the channel — local system integrators and their reference/press pages announcing Kosovo public payment-infrastructure wins — was not scouted in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: After extracting winning-supplier names from the OCDS award data, add each supplier's website, press page and LinkedIn as indirect sources; vendor announcements often state deployed unit counts that the notice omits.

coverage_gaps.description: Portal continuity is not guaranteed — e-Prokurimi was reported inaccessible for six consecutive days, and donor notices (UNDP, IOM, EBRD) are routinely removed after closing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot notices and dossiers at discovery time into a local archive with hashes; do not rely on live re-fetch. Add Wayback submission for key notice URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo law requires notices in Albanian, Serbian and (above thresholds) English, but the multilingual notice versions on e-Prokurimi were not inspected, so it is unknown whether the sr/en versions carry the same technical annexes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch one high-value notice in all three language versions and diff, then decide which language version to treat as canonical for parsing.

brief: Kosovo's public-procurement channel is unusually well consolidated for this cell: one mandatory national portal (e-Prokurimi, run by KRPP/PPRC) carries every contract, award and signed-contract notice, and — critically — the same corpus is exposed as an Open Contracting (OCDS) API and bulk download at ocdskrpp.rks-gov.net covering roughly 2016 to 2026, which should be the primary harvesting route rather than web search. Around that core sit three useful layers: buyer-side document stores (BQK/CBK's own tender page for payment-system and cash-handling procurement, Posta e Kosovës, Dogana, AQP's framework contracts, municipalities under kk.rks-gov.net), accountability layers that expose contract detail the notices omit (the OSHP review-body decisions database, its Demokracia Plus mirror, and National Audit Office reports), and civil-society/media mirrors (prokurimihapur.org in sq/sr/en, KALLXO). The donor and IFI leg is real but fragmented — EBRD ECEPP, World Bank projects/Finances One, UNDP and IOM Kosovo each run their own notices — while TED is structurally near-empty for Kosovo since it is outside the EU directives. Main risks to plan for: item-level ATM/POS notices are effectively unfindable via search engines, full technical dossiers may be gated behind economic-operator registration, and portal/notice availability is not durable, so notices must be archived at discovery.
